posts.title: Tumbling Hedgehog
posts.summary: A comical Eurorack pattern from the Basimilus Iteritas Alter and Qu-Bit Data Bender.
paragraphs: As I was noodling around on my Eurorack trying out the Qu-Bit Data Bender fed from a Basimilus Iteritas Alter module by Noise Engineering, I stumbled upon this strange comical pattern. The track is pretty true to how I captured it, with some minor EQ tweaks and limiting. I like the acoustic textures in this, definitely a strange composition. Have a listen, if you will.
